name: moksha
description: A browser-based spiritual game based on Sanatan Shastra

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.js --bundle --minify --outfile=dist/main.min.js && esbuild style.css --minify --outfile=dist/style.min.css && npx html-minifier-terser index.html --collapse-whitespace --remove-comments --minify-js true --minify-css true -o index.min.html
scripts.package: npm run build && zip -r moksha.zip index.html audio/ dist/
